Name: Custom NPC - Muadhnait
Author: asarigolo
Description:
november 2023: long story short my laptop quite literally caught on fire and i lost the update i was working on that added quite a lot of dialogue, and i couldn't touch stardew valley for three years so disgusted i was 😔 started working on her again though <3 

[center]_____________[/center]

I made her in three days while running a fever (yes. I'm still feverish right now. I just finished her), it's my first mod, I understand nothing about nothing, and it's a miracle she works fine. Honestly, I'm only uploading her because two of my friends like her a bit (and me, too).

Breathtaking self-confidence aside, please don't hesitate to tell me about any bug or problem (or any spelling mistake, because english is not my first language and I'm shit at it)! She doesn't have a lot of content as of right now, but I'm absolutely planning on adding more.
